Friday
Dock Diving
Enter your dog in the class that is most accurate for them. Each terrier will get two jumps that are scored and averaged. There are no practice jumps. Dogs will remain in the class they entered and will not be moved to another class, regardless of their first jump distance. We hope to see those that are trying this event for the first time and those who already compete.

Super Earth
A challenging GTG course with a series of false entrances and/or false tunnels and dens. Open to any Earthworking Terrier 6 months and older. 1 second per foot of tunnel to reach quarry; may leave and re-enter earth several times until the quarry is reached and then must work quarry for one full minute without a break in work and without leaving quarry. May switch from one type of work to another without penalty.

Jacks Are Wild! Poker
You can enter as many dogs as you like. Each dog will have their own poker hand. Participating dogs will receive a playing card for each class in which they are entered, including Sunday classes. You need at least 2 cards per dog. NOT TO EXCEED 5 PLAYING CARDS PER DOG! The dog with the best hand is the Winner!! Jacks ARE Wild!! If you enter multiple dogs, you cannot combine cards to improve your poker hand. Cards will be issued for paid classes only. You will not get additional cards if your dog is moved to a championship class. If your dog is not entered in five classes and you would like to get additional cards, you can pay for additional runs at Tunnel Vision 2.0, Lure Coursing or Barn Hunt to receive another card or you can play fewer than 5 cards. Cards will be issued at the trial office. To play you must pre-enter a dog in the class for this event. Players must draw and report your poker hand, at the time of drawing, to the office by 3:00pm Saturday. At the end of the day Saturday, we will have a winner, after ribbons are handed out. 50% of all the proceeds will go to MOE and the other 50% will go to the winners: 70% to a “Champion” and 30% to a “Reserve Champion”.

Super Earth
A challenging GTG course with a series of false entrances and/or false tunnels and dens. Open to terriers 6 months and older. 1 second per foot of tunnel to reach quarry; may leave and re-enter earth several times until the quarry is reached and then must work quarry for one full minute without a break in work and without leaving quarry. May switch from one type of work to another without penalty.

Dock Diving
Enter your dog in the class that is most accurate for them. Each terrier will get two jumps that are scored and averaged. There are no practice jumps. Dogs will remain in the class they entered and will not be moved to another class, regardless of their first jump distance. We hope to see those that are trying this event for the first time and those who already compete.
